name: fitness-applied/wod-scaling
note: How to scale and how to pace each movement, in Chris's voice (one rule, plain words, no selling). The generator folds these into every workout's introduction. Keys are lexicon movement ids; `scale` is the step down, `cue` is the one thing to remember mid-workout. Reviewed by Chris before launch.

run.scale: Run shorter, or row or bike the same distance.
run.cue: Run at a pace you could hold for twice the distance.

row.scale: Row fewer calories or meters. Keep the stroke long.
row.cue: Long strokes. Pull hard, recover slow.

bike.scale: Fewer calories. Sit down and spin.
bike.cue: Push with the legs, not just the arms.

ski.cue: Hinge at the hips and let your weight do the pulling.

swim.scale: Swim shorter or use a kickboard.
swim.cue: Breathe every stroke if you need to.

ruck.scale: Lighter pack, or walk it without one.
ruck.cue: Short steps. Stand tall under the weight.

shuttle-run.cue: Touch the line every time. Turn low.

double-under.scale: Three single-unders for every double, or 30 seconds of attempts.
double-under.cue: Relax your shoulders. The wrists turn the rope.

deadlift.scale: Lighter bar. Pick a weight you could do the first set unbroken with a flat back.
deadlift.cue: Back straight, bar close. The second the back rounds, the set is over.

pull-up.scale: Ring rows, banded pull-ups, or jumping pull-ups with a slow lower.
pull-up.cue: Break them up early. Small sets from the start beat failing in the middle.

chest-to-bar-pull-up.cue: Open the hips hard and pull the bar to you.

strict-pull-up.scale: Banded strict pull-ups or slow negatives.
strict-pull-up.cue: No kip. Dead hang to chin over.

weighted-pull-up.scale: Lighter weight or strict bodyweight pull-ups.
weighted-pull-up.cue: Full hang at the bottom every rep.

l-pull-up.scale: Tuck the knees instead of straight legs.
l-pull-up.cue: Lock the legs out first, then pull.

thruster.scale: Lighter bar or dumbbells. The bar should move fast on rep one.
thruster.cue: Breathe at the top. Drive the bar up with the legs, not the arms.

burpee.scale: Step back and step up instead of jumping.
burpee.cue: Find a rhythm you can keep. Fast burpees fade; steady ones finish.

bar-facing-burpee.scale: Step over the bar instead of jumping.
bar-facing-burpee.cue: Land facing the bar. Step up, jump over, turn.

burpee-box-jump-over.scale: Lower box, or step up and over.
burpee-box-jump-over.cue: You don't have to stand up on the box. Just get over it.

burpee-over-dumbbell.cue: Lateral, not long. Keep it tight.

burpee-pull-up.cue: Use the jump. Let it carry you to the bar.

push-up.scale: Hands on a box or bench. Knees are fine too.
push-up.cue: Chest to the floor, body in one line.

ring-push-up.scale: Regular push-ups or feet-forward ring push-ups.
ring-push-up.cue: Turn the rings out at the top.

handstand-push-up.scale: Pike push-ups with feet on a box, or dumbbell presses.
handstand-push-up.cue: Head between the hands. Kick to lockout with the legs.

strict-handstand-push-up.scale: Kipping handstand push-ups, pike push-ups, or dumbbell strict presses.

handstand-walk.scale: Shoulder taps against a wall, or bear crawl the distance.
handstand-walk.cue: Look at your hands. Small steps.

handstand-hold.scale: Hold a plank or a pike on a box.
handstand-hold.cue: Squeeze everything. Push the floor away.

wall-walk.scale: Walk half the way up, or hold a plank with feet on the wall.
wall-walk.cue: Hands close to the wall at the top, then walk out fast.

ghd-sit-up.scale: Shorten the range, or do sit-ups on the floor.
ghd-sit-up.cue: If you're new to these, cut the reps in half. They bite two days later.

sit-up.scale: Fewer reps, or anchor your feet.
sit-up.cue: Touch behind your head, touch your toes.

toes-to-bar.scale: Knees to chest, or hanging knee raises.
toes-to-bar.cue: Push the bar away as the toes come up.

knees-to-elbows.cue: Knees high, then let them swing back.

wall-ball.scale: Lighter ball or a lower target. Air squats with a press if you have no ball.
wall-ball.cue: Squat below parallel, throw from the legs, catch it on the way down.

air-squat.cue: Hips below the knees. Full stand at the top.

rope-climb.scale: Lie-to-stand rope pulls, or 3 strict pull-ups per climb.
rope-climb.cue: Climb with your legs. Wrap the rope and stand up.

legless-rope-climb.scale: Rope climbs with legs, or rope pulls from the floor.
legless-rope-climb.cue: Reach high, pull once, reach again.

box-jump.cue: Land soft. Stand all the way up before the next rep.

box-jump-over.cue: You don't need to stand on the box. Over it is enough.

power-clean.scale: Lighter bar, or hang power cleans.
power-clean.cue: Pull it high and get under fast.

hang-clean.cue: Start from above the knee. Jump and catch.

squat-clean.scale: Power clean plus a front squat.
squat-clean.cue: Catch it low and stand it up.

clean-and-jerk.scale: Lighter bar, or power clean and push press.
clean-and-jerk.cue: Reset your feet before the jerk. Don't rush it.

snatch.scale: Lighter bar or power snatches. A dumbbell works too.
snatch.cue: Finish the pull before you drop under.

power-snatch.cue: Bar stays close. Punch to lockout.

hang-power-snatch.cue: From above the knee: jump, pull, lock.

dumbbell-snatch.cue: Switch hands at the floor, not overhead.

kettlebell-snatch.cue: Punch through at the top so the bell lands soft.

overhead-squat.scale: Lighter bar, PVC, or front squats.
overhead-squat.cue: Push up on the bar the whole way down.

back-squat.cue: Big breath, brace, sit down between the knees.

goblet-squat.cue: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom.

pistol.scale: Pistols to a box, or holding a post.
pistol.cue: Reach forward with the arms as you sit.

lunge.cue: Knee kisses the floor, torso tall.

dumbbell-lunge.cue: Stand all the way up between steps.

barbell-lunge.cue: Bar stays over the middle of your foot.

muscle-up.scale: Jumping muscle-ups, or a pull-up plus a ring dip per rep.
muscle-up.cue: Big kip, pull the rings to your hips, turn over fast.

bar-muscle-up.scale: Chest-to-bar pull-ups, or jumping bar muscle-ups.
bar-muscle-up.cue: Pull high and lean over the bar.

strict-muscle-up.scale: Kipping muscle-ups, or strict pull-up plus strict dip.

ring-dip.cue: Shoulders below the elbows at the bottom.

kettlebell-swing.scale: Lighter bell. Russian swings (to eye level) if overhead bothers your shoulders.
kettlebell-swing.cue: It's a hip snap, not an arm lift.

push-press.cue: Dip straight down, drive straight up.

shoulder-press.cue: Squeeze your glutes. No leg drive.

shoulder-to-overhead.cue: Push press when fresh, jerk when tired.

dumbbell-shoulder-to-overhead.cue: Lock both out before you come down.

bench-press.cue: Feet flat, bar to the chest, drive.

sumo-deadlift-high-pull.cue: Hips first, then elbows high and outside.

farmers-carry.cue: Shoulders back. Walk tall, grip hard.

dumbbell-clean.cue: Jump them up. Don't curl them.

medicine-ball-clean.cue: Squat under the ball, don't curl it.

dumbbell-box-step-up.scale: Lighter dumbbells or a lower box.

dumbbell-row.cue: Pull to the hip, not the chest.

dumbbell-deadlift.cue: Same flat back as the barbell.

ground-to-overhead.cue: Any way from the floor to locked out overhead counts.

hip-extension.scale: Fewer reps or a smaller range.
hip-extension.cue: Squeeze the glutes at the top.

back-extension.cue: Round up one vertebra at a time.

plank.cue: Squeeze everything. Don't let the hips sag.

l-sit.scale: Tuck sit, or one leg at a time.
l-sit.cue: Push the floor away. Accumulate the time.

turkish-get-up.cue: Eyes on the weight the whole way.

cindy-round.scale: Ring rows, knee push-ups, squats to a box.
cindy-round.cue: Same pace every round. Don't sprint the first one.
